How it works

Three steps to your next hire

No job postings. No applications. No screening waste. Just verified talent, ready to talk.

Step 01

Candidates interview once

Anyone can complete a full AI-conducted interview on InterviewMe — 15+ questions, scored across 5 dimensions. Free for candidates, permanently.

Step 02

You search & watch

Search by role, seniority, skill, or score threshold. Watch real interview recordings with per-question scores. Know your candidate before you say hello.

Step 03

One invitation. Conversation begins.

Send a direct chat invitation — no job posting, no agency, no gatekeeping. If they're interested, the conversation starts. You've already seen the proof.
